battery.measurement_scope: Entire capture, including awake and suspend/resume overhead
battery.power_check_scope: Endpoints only; keep all external power disconnected throughout

assessment.known_resume_warning: SDHCI/PCIe hotplug teardown: Trying to free already-free IRQ 330; same warning observed in prior tests and on the stock kernel.

limitations: Whole-capture energy includes 32.741596 seconds outside machine_suspend; it is not isolated steady-state suspend power.
The planned 60-second manual resume wait was not observed: the sample was taken about 17.9 seconds after the logged lid opening. Gauge settling was therefore not verified as planned.
Battery and external-power state are checked only at capture endpoints.
Full-battery duration and overnight loss are constant-rate extrapolations from one approximately two-hour test, not measured endurance.
The earlier 30-minute run had unchanged energy readings; gauge behavior remains a source of uncertainty.
next_step: An optional overnight repeat can validate the projected drain; keep the same setup and actually wait at least 60 seconds after lid opening before typing done.
